zh.title: 美國FAA正式核發波音737 MAX 7修改後型別認證
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年8月3日正式對波音737 MAX 7核發修改後的型別認證與更新的生產限制紀錄。在此之前，FAA要求該機型必須進行多項關鍵改進，包括飛行控制軟體更新、機組員警示系統優化以及重新設計的引擎防冰系統。該機型先前為MAX家族中最後兩款等待認證的衍生機型之一。
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年8月3日正式對波音（Boeing）737 MAX-7客機核發修改後的型別認證，並更新其生產限制紀錄。此項決定代表了雙方歷經將近十年的廣泛審查、解決複雜技術問題並完成詳細安全分析後的重要進展。FAA表示，此項認證確認該款飛機符合所有適用的設計與安全標準，而更新後的生產限制紀錄也正式授權波音開始量產此款機型。
在正式授予此項核准之前，FAA要求波音737 MAX-7必須納入多項關鍵改進措施，以符合《飛機認證、安全與問責法》之規定及美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）的建議。這些關鍵改進包括飛行控制軟體的更新、機組員警示系統的優化，以及重新設計的引擎防冰系統。新系統的設計目的在於提供飛行員更清晰的資訊與警告，並防止引擎進氣口過熱而可能削弱周邊結構的風險。
儘管認證已經核發，FAA表示其安全監察員仍將繼續派駐於波音位於全美各地的生產工廠，密切監督整個製造過程，並對波音的安全管理系統（SMS）以及安全文化進行觀察與評估。

根據 Simple Flying 報導，737 MAX-7 與 MAX-10 是波音 737 MAX 家族中最後兩款等待認證的衍生機型。先前歷史資料顯示，這款最小型的 MAX 衍生機型受到許多客戶高度關注，例如西南航空（Southwest Airlines）其整個商業模式都圍繞著單一機型機隊運作，因而一直在等待該機型的交付。隨著 MAX-7 順利取得 FAA 認證，這款飛機將能推進後續的量產與交付時程。

en.title: FAA Grants Amended Type Certification to Boeing 737 MAX 7
en.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on August 3, 2026, officially issued an amended type certificate and updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX-7. To secure this approval, the aircraft was required to incorporate major improvements, including flight-control software updates, flightcrew alerting enhancements, and a redesigned engine anti-ice system. FAA inspectors will remain on site at Boeing facilities to monitor production. The MAX 7, alongside the MAX 10, had been one of the final two variants in the MAX family awaiting certification, a milestone long awaited by customers such as Southwest Airlines.
body: The United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on August 3, 2026, that it has issued an amended type certificate and an updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX-7. This approval comes after nearly a decade of extensive review, during which the regulatory body worked to resolve complex technical issues and conduct a thorough analysis of the aircraft's design. The newly issued certificate confirms that the aircraft complies with all applicable safety and design requirements, while the updated record formally authorizes Boeing to begin production of the variant.

Before granting the certification, the FAA mandated that the Boeing 737 MAX-7 incorporate several critical design improvements. These enhancements address requirements established under the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, as well as recommendations from the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB). Specifically, the aircraft underwent updates to its flight-control software and flightcrew alerting system, alongside a redesigned engine anti-ice system. These design changes are intended to provide pilots with clearer alerts and prevent the engine inlet from overheating, which could otherwise weaken the surrounding structure.

Even as production is authorized to begin, the regulatory agency emphasized that safety oversight will remain stringent. The FAA stated that its safety inspectors will continue to be stationed on site at Boeing's manufacturing facilities across the nation. These inspectors will closely monitor the production process, while observing and assessing the implementation of Boeing's Safety Management System (SMS) and broader safety culture.

According to previous reports from Simple Flying, the 737 MAX-7 and the larger MAX-10 represent the final two variants of the Boeing 737 MAX family that were awaiting official certification. The milestone is particularly critical for airline customers like Southwest Airlines, whose business model has traditionally relied on a single aircraft type. The approval of the MAX-7 clears a major regulatory hurdle, paving the way for eventual airline deliveries and the modernization of carrier fleets.

en.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on Monday, July 27, that seats installed on hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX aircraft registered in the United States may require formal inspections due to suspicions of improper installation. According to the aviation authority, the affected seats must be repaired and properly fixed after concerns were raised regarding their installation process. This announcement impacts numerous Boeing 737 MAX aircraft operating under United States registry as regulators move to address the potential installation issue.
body: On Monday, July 27, the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that seats installed on hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX aircraft registered in the United States may need to undergo formal inspections.

The regulatory agency stated that the potential inspection requirement stems from suspicions that the seats were incorrectly installed. The concern applies specifically to hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX jets on the U.S. civil aircraft registry.
According to the official FAA statement, any seats suspected of having been incorrectly installed on these Boeing 737 MAX aircraft must be properly fixed.

zh.summary: 希臘於2026年8月3日發生滅火直升機空中相撞事故，兩架由麥克德莫特航空擁有的貝爾直升機在阿提卡大區執行滅火任務時碰撞，造成兩名機組人員身亡、兩人輕傷。希臘民防部門已預防性暫停境內所有貝爾直升機作業，相關單位正著手調查事故原因。
body: 希臘阿提卡大區於2026年8月3日發生一起空中相撞事故。兩架執行滅火任務的貝爾直升機在雅典以西約65公里的普薩薩附近相撞，導致其中一架直升機墜毀起火，另一架則緊急降落。事故造成一名丹麥籍飛行員與一名希臘消防連絡官不幸身亡，另一架直升機上的英國飛行員與希臘協調員則受輕傷。
涉事直升機屬澳洲麥克德莫特航空（McDermott Aviation）所有，出租用於海外滅火作業。事故發生後，希臘民防部門已預防性暫停境內所有貝爾直升機的作業。麥克德莫特航空證實有人員殉職，並表示正密切配合希臘當局調查事故原因。

en.title: Two Killed in Mid-Air Collision of Firefighting Helicopters in Greece
en.summary: Two crew members were killed and two others sustained minor injuries on August 3, 2026, after two Bell firefighting helicopters collided mid-air near Psatha in Greece's Attica region. The aircraft were owned by Australian firm McDermott Aviation and leased for wildfire operations. Following the collision, Greek civil protection authorities grounded all Bell helicopters in the country as a precautionary measure, while McDermott Aviation confirmed it is cooperating with ongoing investigations into the cause of the accident.
body: Two firefighting helicopters collided mid-air in Greece's Attica region on August 3, 2026, while battling wildfires approximately 65 kilometers west of Athens. The collision resulted in the deaths of a Danish pilot and a Greek fire service liaison officer aboard one aircraft, while a British pilot and a Greek coordinator on the second helicopter survived with minor injuries.

Both Bell helicopters were owned by Australian company McDermott Aviation, which leases firefighting aircraft internationally. Following the accident, Greek civil protection authorities grounded all Bell helicopters operating in the country as a precaution. McDermott Aviation expressed condolences and confirmed it is cooperating fully with Greek investigators to determine the cause of the crash.

zh.title: 馬來西亞民航局針對馬航機師涉毒案展開安檢程序調查
zh.summary: 馬來西亞民航局於8月2日宣布，針對吉隆坡國際機場的安檢程序展開監管調查。此調查起因於馬來西亞航空一名執飛MH727航班的機師，於7月28日在印尼雅加達因涉嫌走私約25公斤毒品遭扣留。馬來西亞警方亦於8月1日證實展開平行刑事調查，調閱安檢紀錄與監視器畫面。
body: 馬來西亞民航局（CAAM）於2026年8月2日宣布，已對吉隆坡國際機場的航空安全程序啟動監管調查。這項審查將評估航空公司是否完全符合航空安全法規，並檢視班機從馬來西亞起飛之前所執行的機場安全檢查程序，以確認機師離境前是否切實遵守所有安全要求。
該起事件始於2026年7月28日，印尼海關人員在由吉隆坡飛抵雅加達蘇凱諾-哈達國際機場的馬來西亞航空MH727航班降落後，扣留了一名馬來西亞航空機師。印尼當局指控，在該名機師的隨身行李中查獲隱藏的約25公斤搖頭丸與冰毒，數量相當於超過7萬粒膠囊，估算街頭價值約為1050萬美元。
馬來西亞警方於8月1日證實已展開平行的刑事調查，正調閱吉隆坡國際機場的監視器畫面與行李安檢紀錄，並與印尼當局密切合作。調查人員同時正在排查該起案件是否與更廣泛的跨國販毒集團有關，以及航空航線是否遭到走私運作利用。
馬來西亞民航局執行長Norazman Mahmud表示，監管單位的審查旨在確定飛機起飛前是否遵循了所有適用的安全措施。他強調機組人員並未獲得機場安全檢查的豁免權，進入安全管制區域時，必須依據2019年馬來西亞民航安全法規與國家民航安全計畫，與其他人一樣接受手提行李及個人物品的X光檢查等安檢程序。
馬來西亞民航局補充說明，目前正在收集相關證據，若確認有任何違反航空法規或安全要求的行為，將在其管轄權範圍內採取適當的執法行動。馬來西亞航空則表示，公司正全力配合印尼當局的調查，同時正同步進行內部審查程序。

en.title: Malaysia CAAM Probes Airport Security After Pilot Arrested for Drug Smuggling
en.summary: Malaysia's Civil Aviation Authority (CAAM) launched a regulatory investigation on August 2 into airport security procedures at Kuala Lumpur International Airport following the arrest of a Malaysia Airlines pilot in Indonesia. The pilot was detained by Indonesian customs officers on July 28 after flight MH727 arrived at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, where authorities allegedly found approximately 25 kilograms of ecstasy and methamphetamine hidden in luggage. Malaysian police confirmed on August 1 that they have opened a parallel criminal probe, reviewing CCTV footage and airport screening records.
body: Malaysia’s Civil Aviation Authority (CAAM) announced on August 2 that it has opened a regulatory investigation into airport security procedures following the arrest of a Malaysia Airlines pilot in Indonesia on alleged drug smuggling charges. The regulator said the probe will examine whether all aviation security requirements were fully complied with before the pilot departed Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA), assessing airline compliance as well as airport screening procedures.

The investigation follows an incident on July 28, 2026, when Indonesian customs officers detained the Malaysia Airlines pilot after the arrival of flight MH727 from Kuala Lumpur (KUL) at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK). Indonesian authorities allege they discovered approximately 25 kilograms of ecstasy pills and methamphetamine, equivalent to more than 70,000 capsules, concealed in the pilot’s luggage, with an estimated street value of around $10.5 million.

On August 1, Malaysian police confirmed that they had launched a parallel criminal investigation. Investigators are reviewing CCTV footage and baggage screening records at KLIA while cooperating with Indonesian authorities. Police are also examining whether the case is connected to a wider cross-border drug trafficking syndicate and if commercial aviation routes were exploited for illicit smuggling operations.

CAAM Chief Executive Datuk Captain Norazman Mahmud stated that the regulatory review will determine whether all applicable security measures were followed prior to the aircraft’s departure. He emphasized that flight crew members are not exempt from airport security screening and must undergo the same security screening as all other individuals entering security-restricted areas, including X-ray inspections of cabin baggage and personal items under Malaysia's Civil Aviation Security Regulations 2019 and the National Civil Aviation Security Program.

The aviation regulator added that it is gathering evidence and will take enforcement action within its jurisdiction if any violations of aviation regulations or security requirements are identified. Malaysia Airlines stated that it is fully cooperating with the Indonesian investigation while conducting its own internal review into the incident.

body: 國防部於8月3日公布最新的共機艦動態，統計自8月2日上午6時起至8月3日上午6時止，共偵獲7艘共艦、3艘公務船以及1架共機在台灣周邊活動。

相較於前一日國防部公布的動態，共艦數量由8艘略降為7艘，公務船數量則由2艘增至3艘，共機則由5架次（其中3架次逾越海峽中線）降為1架次。
國防部強調，國軍持續在台海周邊活動，確保國家安全。

en.title: Taiwan detects 7 PLAN vessels, 3 official ships, 1 PLA aircraft near its waters
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting 7 PLA vessels, 3 official ships, and 1 PLA aircraft operating near Taiwan between 6 a.m. Aug. 2 and 6 a.m. Aug. 3. The military responded with task force ships and coastal missile systems.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense (MND) released the latest PLA activity report on Aug. 3, detailing movements detected between 6 a.m. on Aug. 2 and 6 a.m. on Aug. 3.
During this period, the MND detected 7 People's Liberation Army (PLA) vessels, 3 official ships, and 1 PLA aircraft. The aircraft entered Taiwan's southwestern airspace.
Taiwan's armed forces responded by monitoring the situation and deploying task force ships, aircraft, and coastal missile systems.
The report follows the previous day's figures of 8 PLA vessels, 2 official ships, and 5 PLA aircraft, 3 of which crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait.

body: Greece's fire service confirmed that two people died in a crash involving a firefighting helicopter, Reuters reported on August 2.

The report from Reuters cited the official fire service announcement confirming the fatalities, while the BBC report highlighted the nature of the collision and the nationality of the surviving pilot.

en.summary: Brazil's competition authority, the Administrative Council for Economic Defense (CADE), has approved American Airlines' planned $100 million investment in Azul without conditions. CADE also evaluated planned commercial cooperation between the carriers, including expanded codeshare agreements and reciprocal frequent flyer program benefits, concluding that the transaction is unlikely to harm market competition.
body: Brazil's competition authority, the Administrative Council for Economic Defense (CADE), has cleared American Airlines' planned $100 million investment in Azul without conditions, finding the deal unlikely to harm market competition.

zh.title: 西捷航空客艙組員展開罷工 已導致逾300班次取消
zh.summary: 西捷航空約4,400名客艙組員於2026年8月2日展開罷工，主因與工會8125分會談判破裂。爭議焦點為起飛前與降落後的勤務薪資。罷工已導致超過300個航班取消，波音737與787航線受影響，但WestJet Encore營運之Dash 8 Q400航班維持正常。
body: 西捷航空（WestJet）約4,400名客艙組員於2026年8月2日正式發起罷工行動。在此之前，西捷航空與加拿大公共僱員工會（CUPE）8125分會進行了近11個月的團體協約談判，但最終未能達成新協議。罷工行動隨即展開，並對西捷航空的整體航網營運造成重大影響，已有超過300個航班被迫取消。
為因應罷工可能帶來的衝擊，西捷航空在罷工正式開始前，已著手停飛部分波音（Boeing）737機隊，以降低營運中斷的程度，並避免旅客與客機滯留於外站。工會8125分會理事長Alia Hussain表示，工會直到最後一刻都在努力爭取一份能體現客艙組員工作價值的合理協議，但西捷航空提出的方案仍顯不足。
此次勞資爭議的核心，在於空服員在航班起飛前與降落後所執行的勤務報酬計算方式。工會主張，現行體制下這些地面勤務並未獲得相應薪資；西捷航空則表示，現行的薪酬模式已涵蓋該部分工作。航空公司指出，其最新的提議中已包含起飛前與降落後所有勤務的薪資保障，並承諾在協定生效的第一年提供雙位數的調薪幅度。
西捷航空證實，受到本次罷工影響的航線主要為波音737與波音787機隊執飛的航班。相對地，由WestJet Encore營運、採用De Havilland Dash 8 Q400客機執飛的航班，以及與合作航空公司聯營的代碼共享航班，目前均按照既定時程維持正常營運。

en.title: WestJet Cabin Crew Launch Strike, Forcing Cancellation of Over 300 Flights
en.summary: Approximately 4,400 WestJet cabin crew members went on strike on August 2, 2026, following the breakdown of collective bargaining negotiations between the airline and CUPE Local 8125. The core of the dispute involves compensation for flight attendant duties performed prior to departure and after arrival. The strike has already forced WestJet to cancel more than 300 flights across its network. WestJet confirmed that flights operated by its Boeing 737 and Boeing 787 aircraft are impacted, while WestJet Encore flights operated with De Havilland Dash 8 Q400 aircraft continue to operate as scheduled.
body: More than 4,400 WestJet cabin crew members officially launched strike action on August 2, 2026, after nearly 11 months of contract negotiations between the Canadian carrier and the Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE) Local 8125 failed to produce a new collective agreement. The strike action has already significantly disrupted WestJet main operational network, forcing the airline to cancel more than 300 flights.

In anticipation of the strike action, WestJet began grounding parts of its Boeing 737 fleet prior to the deadline in an effort to minimize operational disruption and prevent aircraft and passengers from being stranded. CUPE Local 8125 President Alia Hussain stated that the union attempted until the very last minute to secure a fair agreement recognizing the value of cabin crew work, but maintained that WestJet proposal did not go far enough.

The core dispute centers on how flight attendants are compensated for duties performed before departure and after arrival. The union contends that ground responsibilities remain unpaid under the current system. In response, WestJet stated that its existing compensation model covers these duties, adding that its latest offer included pay for all pre-flight and post-flight duties alongside a double-digit wage increase during the first year of the agreement.

According to official statements from the airline, flight operations conducted using Boeing 737 and Boeing 787 aircraft are directly affected by the ongoing strike action. However, regional WestJet Encore services operated with De Havilland Dash 8 Q400 aircraft, as well as codeshare flights operated by international partner airlines, continue to operate as scheduled across the airline network.

zh.title: 空中巴士上半年營收達332億歐元 淨利升至22.4億歐元
zh.summary: 空中巴士公布2026年上半年財務業績，受商用飛機交付量增加與國防業務成長推動，總營收年增12%至332億歐元，淨利達22.4億歐元。期間共交付351架商用飛機，新接淨訂單達821架，截至6月底手握訂單達9,222架。空中巴士維持全年交付約870架飛機及調整後EBIT約75億歐元的目標。
body: 空中巴士公布2026年上半年財務業績，受惠於商用飛機交付量增加與國防業務需求強勁，整體營運表現明顯提升。在2026年前六個月中，空中巴士共交付351架商用飛機，高於2025年同期的306架。這推動集團總營收年增12%達到332億歐元，調整後息稅前利潤（EBIT）成長24%至27億歐元，淨利則由去年同期的15.3億歐元增至22.4億歐元。
商用飛機部門仍是空中巴士主要的業績支柱，上半年實現營收239億歐元，較去年同期成長15%。在交付機型方面，空中巴士於1月至6月期間共交付44架A220飛機、271架A320系列飛機、10架A330飛機以及26架A350飛機。商用飛機部門調整後EBIT由去年同期的17億歐元升至20億歐元，不過公司指出，交付量增加帶來的效益部分被貨幣避險的影響所抵銷。
新機市場需求持續保持強勁。空中巴士在上半年錄得886架商用飛機總訂單，扣除取消訂單後，淨訂單數達821架，較2025年上半年的402架增加一倍以上。截至6月底，空中巴士手握的商用飛機積壓訂單總量已達9,222架。此外，公司重申各機型的產能提升目標，包括計劃在2027年底前將A320系列飛機月產量提升至70至75架，並持續推動A220、A330及A350的增產進度。

en.title: Airbus Reports €33.2B H1 2026 Revenue as Deliveries and Defence Demand Rise
en.summary: Airbus reported an improved financial performance for the first half of 2026, generated by higher commercial aircraft deliveries and strong defence demand. Consolidated revenue increased 12% year-on-year to €33.2 billion, while net income rose to €2.24 billion. The planemaker delivered 351 commercial aircraft during the six-month period, up from 306 in H1 2025, and recorded 821 net orders, taking its backlog to 9,222 aircraft. Airbus Defence and Space revenue grew 9% to €6.3 billion. The European manufacturer reiterated its full-year guidance to deliver approximately 870 commercial aircraft and achieve an adjusted EBIT of around €7.5 billion in 2026.
body: Airbus reported an improvement in its financial performance for the second quarter and first half of 2026, boosted by higher commercial aircraft deliveries and robust activity in its defence sector. During the first six months of 2026, the European aircraft manufacturer delivered 351 commercial aircraft, compared with 306 units delivered during the same period in 2025. This delivery growth helped consolidated revenues increase by 12% year-on-year to €33.2 billion. Consolidated adjusted EBIT rose 24% to €2.7 billion, while net income reached €2.24 billion, up from €1.53 billion recorded in the first half of 2025.

The commercial aircraft business remained the core driver of the planemaker's overall performance, generating €23.9 billion in revenue during the first half of the year, representing a 15% increase compared to H1 2025. Between January and June 2026, Airbus delivered 44 A220s, 271 A320-family aircraft, 10 A330s, and 26 A350s. Adjusted EBIT for the commercial aircraft division rose from €1.7 billion to €2.0 billion, although the manufacturer noted that the positive financial impact of higher aircraft deliveries was partially offset by currency hedging effects.

Demand for new commercial aircraft remained strong throughout the period. Airbus recorded 886 gross commercial orders during the first half of 2026, up from 494 gross orders in H1 2025. Net orders after cancellations reached 821 aircraft, more than double the 402 net orders recorded in the previous year's first half. As a result, the manufacturer's total commercial aircraft backlog stood at 9,222 aircraft at the end of June 2026. Airbus also confirmed its ongoing production ramp-up targets across its programmes, including reaching a monthly production rate of between 70 and 75 aircraft for the A320 family by late 2027.

In non-commercial sectors, Airbus Defence and Space reported a revenue increase of 9% to €6.3 billion, with adjusted EBIT rising to €487 million compared with €265 million a year earlier. Order intake for the defence unit reached €9.3 billion during the first half. Airbus Helicopters generated stable revenue of €3.7 billion with 144 deliveries. Despite persistent global trade uncertainties and supply chain challenges, Airbus maintained its full-year 2026 targets, aiming to deliver approximately 870 commercial aircraft and achieve an adjusted EBIT of around €7.5 billion.

en.title: ANA expands Embraer E190-E2 order with eight more jets to strengthen Japan regional network
en.summary: All Nippon Airways (ANA) has placed an additional firm order for eight Embraer E190-E2 aircraft, taking its total commitment for the next-generation regional jet to 28 aircraft. The new planes will support an expanded ACMI arrangement for the airline’s domestic services.
body: All Nippon Airways (ANA) announced on July 29 that its board approved an order for a further eight Embraer E190-E2 aircraft, deepening its commitment to the Brazilian planemaker.
The latest order builds on the 20-aircraft commitment announced in February 2025, which comprised 15 firm orders and five purchase options, bringing the total E190-E2 order book to 28 firm aircraft.
Koji Shibata, president and chief executive of ANA Holdings, stated: 'This additional E190-E2 order accelerates our efforts to build a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan.'

en.title: Rolls-Royce Operating Profit Rises 46% and Raises 2026 Full-Year Guidance
en.summary: Rolls-Royce reported a 46% year-on-year increase in underlying operating profit to 2.5 billion pounds for the half-year, achieving an underlying operating margin of 22.5%. The engine manufacturer raised its full-year 2026 financial guidance, now forecasting underlying operating profit between 4.7 billion and 4.9 billion pounds, alongside free cash flow of 3.8 billion to 4.0 billion pounds. Chief Executive Tufan Erginbilgic noted that the Civil Aerospace division has improved aftermarket profitability and effectively eliminated aircraft on the ground. Additionally, three airlines, including LATAM Airlines, selected the new Trent 1000 XE engine for their Boeing 787 Dreamliner fleets in 2026.
body: Rolls-Royce reported half-year financial results showing a 46% year-on-year increase in underlying operating profit to 2.5 billion pounds. The company achieved an underlying operating margin of 22.5%, driven by higher profitability across all divisions.

Chief Executive Tufan Erginbilgic stated that the Civil Aerospace unit improved aftermarket profitability and effectively eliminated aircraft on the ground. In 2026, three airlines, including LATAM Airlines, selected the new Trent 1000 XE engine for Boeing 787 Dreamliners.

body: 美國航空一架波音737與一架E175支線客機在華盛頓雷根國家機場（DCA）發生一起近距離接近事件。根據Simple Flying報導，兩架飛機一度僅相距約800英尺。

據報導，塔台管制員發現情況後立即介入，指示雙方飛機停止動作，避免了可能發生的碰撞。
目前相關單位已就此事件展開調查。Simple Flying的報導提供了事件的初步細節，但未透露確切日期、航班編號與飛機註冊編號。

en.title: American Airlines 737 and E175 Nearly Collide at Washington Reagan, Only 800 Feet Apart
en.summary: An American Airlines Boeing 737 and an E175 regional jet came within 800 feet of each other at Washington Reagan National Airport (DCA) after the regional jet mistakenly accepted a runway clearance meant for another aircraft. An investigation is underway.
body: An American Airlines Boeing 737 and an E175 regional jet were involved in a close-call incident at Washington Reagan National Airport (DCA). According to Simple Flying, the two aircraft came within approximately 800 feet of each other.
The event occurred after the E175 crew mistakenly accepted a takeoff clearance intended for a different aircraft, leading them to prepare to enter a runway already in use.
Air traffic controllers intervened, instructing both aircraft to halt, thereby averting a potential collision.
Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident. Simple Flying's report provided initial details but did not disclose the exact date, flight numbers, or aircraft registration numbers.
AVWIRE will follow the investigation and provide updates as more official information becomes available.

en.title: Israel Explores Stealth Drone, Indigenous Fighter to Cut US Reliance
en.summary: Israel is laying the groundwork for an indigenous airpower strategy that could involve a stealth combat drone, a homegrown fighter jet and long-range missiles, aiming to reduce long-term dependence on US military assistance and expand defence production through international partnerships.
body: The Israeli government is laying foundations for an indigenous airpower strategy that could eventually include a stealth combat drone, a homegrown fighter aircraft and long-range missiles as it prepares for a future with less reliance on US military support.

According to Bloomberg, citing a senior Israeli official, the aircraft concept is being examined as part of a wider plan to strengthen Israel's domestic defence industry, reduce long-term reliance on US military assistance and expand future weapons development through international partnerships.
The proposal remains at an early stage: no contractor has been selected, no development timetable announced, and Israel's Ministry of Defence has not formally launched such a programme.

Since the late 1980s the Israeli Air Force has relied almost exclusively on American-built fighters, including successive F-15s, F-16s and the F-35I "Adir", so any shift toward indigenous combat aircraft would represent a profound change for the service.

en.title: FAA Finalizes 100LL Leaded Avgas Phaseout Plan With 2030 Deadline
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has released its final 72-page plan to eliminate leaded 100LL aviation gasoline across the United States. The plan establishes a four-phase transition strategy, setting a deadline of December 31, 2030, for ending leaded avgas use outside Alaska, while granting Alaska until the end of 2032 due to logistical challenges. The initial phase focuses on evaluating high-octane unleaded fuel alternatives, with testing scheduled for completion in spring 2027. Phase 2 will run through mid-to-late 2028 to expand operational experience and initiate FAA rulemaking for unleaded avgas standards.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has released a 72-page final plan to phase out 100LL leaded aviation gasoline across the United States. The plan sets a deadline of December 31, 2030, to end leaded fuel use outside Alaska, while giving Alaska until the end of 2032 due to local distribution and storage challenges.

The transition consists of four phases. Phase 1 evaluates three high-octane unleaded fuel candidates—G100UL, 100R, and UL100—with testing scheduled to conclude in spring 2027. Phase 2, running through mid-to-late 2028, will expand operating experience and initiate FAA rulemaking to establish regulatory standards for unleaded avgas.

Speaking at a forum during EAA AirVenture 2026, FAA Deputy Administrator Chris Rocheleau referred to the 2030 phaseout deadline as aggressive while reiterating the agency's commitment to ensuring a structured regulatory transition.

zh.title: Sling Aircraft 揭露開發中雙引擎飛機細節以瞄準 MOSAIC 市場
zh.summary: 南非製造商 Sling Aircraft 已公布其開發中雙引擎活塞飛機的首批技術細節。該機型計畫提供四座輕型運動飛機 (LSA) 與六座實驗性自建 (EA-B) 兩種配置，並將搭載兩具 Rotax 916 iS 渦輪增壓引擎及 Garmin AXIS 顯示器。
body: 南非製造商 Sling Aircraft 已公布其正在開發中的新型雙引擎活塞飛機的首批技術細節。根據該公司計畫，此機型將提供四座輕型運動飛機 (LSA) 與六座實驗性自建 (EA-B) 兩種配置。
該機型預計將搭載兩具 Rotax 916 iS 渦輪增壓引擎，並驅動定速螺旋槳。座艙將配備 Garmin AXIS 11.6 吋顯示器，且設計之初便整合了全機降落傘系統。
此開發計畫旨在瞄準美國聯邦航空局 (FAA) 的「現代化特殊適航認證」規則，即 MOSAIC。根據該規則，輕型運動飛機可搭載多個引擎，並允許載客量增加至四人。
目前 Sling Aircraft 尚未公布該機型的性能目標、尺寸、預計售價、首飛時間或客戶交付日期。目前的設計圖像僅為概念性渲染圖，包含低翼設計與可收縮的三輪起落架。

en.title: Sling Aircraft reveals details of planned twin-engine aircraft targeting MOSAIC market
en.summary: South African manufacturer Sling Aircraft has revealed technical details for a new twin-engine piston aircraft under development. The aircraft is planned for both four-seat light-sport (LSA) and six-seat Experimental Amateur-Built (EA-B) configurations, featuring twin Rotax 916 iS engines.
body: Sling Aircraft has disclosed the first technical details of a new twin-engine piston aircraft currently under development. The South African manufacturer plans to offer the aircraft in both four-seat light-sport (LSA) and six-seat Experimental Amateur-Built (EA-B) configurations.

The aircraft will utilize two turbocharged Rotax 916 iS engines driving constant-speed propellers. The cockpit is expected to feature Garmin AXIS 11.6-inch displays, and a whole-airplane parachute will be incorporated into the design from the outset.

The development targets the FAA's Modernization of Special Airworthiness Certification (MOSAIC) rule. Under MOSAIC, light-sport aircraft may be configured with multiple engines and carry up to four occupants.

Sling Aircraft has not yet disclosed performance targets, dimensions, projected pricing, first-flight timing, or a planned date for customer deliveries. Current renderings show a low-wing design with retractable tricycle landing gear.

zh.title: 日本防衛省宣布神盾驅逐艦鳥海號首度試射戰斧巡弋飛彈
zh.summary: 日本防衛省於2026年7月30日宣布，海上自衛隊神盾驅逐艦鳥海號（DDG-176）於7月29日在太平洋成功進行戰斧巡弋飛彈實彈射擊測試，為日本軍艦首次發射該型飛彈。日本透過美國軍售管道採購多達400枚戰斧飛彈，並編列約1136億日圓預算改裝五艘神盾艦。
body: 日本防衛省於2026年7月30日宣布，海上自衛隊神盾驅逐艦鳥海號（DDG-176）於7月29日在太平洋成功進行戰斧巡弋飛彈實彈射擊測試。這是日本軍艦首次發射該型飛彈，相關測試在美國海軍支援下進行，確認鳥海號具備實際發射戰斧飛彈的能力，並驗證了官兵進行發射程序的熟練度。
金剛級神盾驅逐艦鳥海號自2025年10月起部署至美國進行艦體改裝與官兵訓練。防衛省先前於2026年3月27日宣布該艦已取得戰斧飛彈發射能力，使其成為首艘完成相關配置的日本軍艦。鳥海號預計於2026年9月左右返回日本，並以佐世保為母港。
日本防衛省指出，本次試射展現了戰斧飛彈計畫的穩健進展，未來將繼續致力於儘早建立防衛戰略所規劃的反擊能力。美國海軍在測試期間提供試射場地並監控週邊海空域，而實際發射作業則由日本官兵執行。防衛省表示，由於Mk 41垂直發射系統與戰斧飛彈在美國海軍已擁有廣泛服役紀錄，因此暫無計畫在其他改裝中的神盾艦上進行類似實彈測試。
根據日本防衛省統計，截至2026年度已批准約1136億日圓預算，用於為五艘海上自衛隊神盾驅逐艦新增戰斧飛彈發射能力，包含鳥海號、霧島號、羽黑號、妙高號與愛宕號。此外，日本正透過美國對外軍售（FMS）管道採購最多400枚戰斧飛彈，總費用約為169.4億日圓。本次試射也使日本成為繼澳洲與荷蘭之後，全球第三個由水面艦艇發射戰斧飛彈的美國盟邦。

en.title: Japan JMSDF Destroyer JS Chokai Conducts First Tomahawk Live-Fire Test
en.summary: Japan's Ministry of Defense announced on July 30, 2026, that the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force destroyer JS Chokai (DDG-176) successfully executed a live-fire test of a Tomahawk cruise missile in the Pacific Ocean on July 29, 2026. The test, conducted with assistance from the US Navy, marks the first time a Japanese warship has fired a Tomahawk missile. Japan is acquiring up to 400 Tomahawk missiles through the US Foreign Military Sales program for approximately 169.4 billion yen ($1.03 billion) and has approved 113.6 billion yen to equip five Aegis destroyers with launch capabilities.
body: Japan's Ministry of Defense announced on July 30, 2026, that the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Aegis destroyer JS Chokai (DDG-176) carried out a live-fire test of a Tomahawk cruise missile in the Pacific Ocean on July 29, 2026. The test, conducted with assistance from the US Navy, marks the first time a Japanese warship has launched a Tomahawk missile. The ministry confirmed that the firing sequence verified the crew's proficiency and demonstrated the ship's practical capability to launch the weapon system.

JS Chokai, a Kongo-class Aegis destroyer, has been deployed to the United States since October 2025 for modification work and crew training. The Ministry of Defense previously announced on March 27, 2026, that the warship had successfully acquired Tomahawk launch capability, becoming the first Japanese surface vessel configured for such missions. The ship is scheduled to return to Japan around September 2026, where it will be homeported at Sasebo.

The ministry described the successful launch as evidence of steady progress in its standoff defense program initiated under Japan's 2022 National Security Strategy. While the US Navy provided the test range and monitored surrounding maritime and airspace safety, the actual launch sequence was executed entirely by the Japanese crew. Defense officials noted that no additional live-fire tests are planned for other modifying Aegis destroyers, as the Mk 41 vertical launching system and Tomahawk missile already possess extensive operational service records with the US Navy.

Approved defense funding through fiscal year 2026 covers approximately 113.6 billion yen ($694 million) to integrate Tomahawk capabilities across five of Japan's eight Aegis destroyers, including Chokai, Kirishima, Haguro, Myoko, and Atago. Japan is purchasing up to 400 Tomahawk missiles through the US Foreign Military Sales program at an estimated cost of 169.4 billion yen ($1.03 billion). With this test, Japan becomes the third nation outside the United States to launch a Tomahawk missile from a surface warship, following Australia and the Netherlands.

zh.title: 俄羅斯增撥資金推進MC-21量產 並資助首三架IL-114-300客機
zh.summary: 俄羅斯政府於2026年7月30日宣布加碼投資國產客機生產。雅克列夫公司伊爾庫茨克廠現有18架MC-21-310客機處於各生產階段，據ch-aviation資料，啟始客戶俄羅斯航空正等待交付198架。同時當局撥款3280萬美元資助完成首三架IL-114-300客機，交付阿爾漢格爾斯克航空企業。
body: 俄羅斯總理米舒斯京於2026年7月30日表示，政府已確定資金以推進商業客機量產，並向啟始客戶俄羅斯航空交付客機。目前位於雅克列夫旗下伊爾庫茨克飛機製造廠內，共有18架MC-21-310客機處於不同的生產階段。
根據ch-aviation資料顯示，俄羅斯航空目前等待接收198架MC-21-310客機。該機型預計於2027年6月完成認證程序，俄方並計畫在2032年前實現每年生產36架MC-21客機的目標。
在區域客機方面，俄羅斯政府撥款3280萬美元（約26億盧布），用於完成俄羅斯國家技術集團旗下聯合航空製造公司（UAC）子公司伊留申開發的首三架IL-114-300渦輪螺旋槳客機。該機型已於2026年6月取得型別認證，首三架將交付給阿爾漢格爾斯克航空企業。

en.title: Russia Increases Funding for MC-21 Production and IL-114-300 Turboprops
en.summary: Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin announced on July 30, 2026, enhanced government funding for commercial aircraft production. The funding supports 18 MC-21-310 aircraft currently at various production stages at Yakovlev’s Irkutsk Aircraft Plant, aiming to supply launch customer Aeroflot, which according to ch-aviation data is awaiting 198 aircraft. Additionally, Russia allocated $32.8 million (RUB 2.6 billion) to complete the first three IL-114-300 turboprop passenger aircraft developed by Ilyushin, which received type certification in June 2026 and are slated for delivery to Arkhangelsk Aviation Enterprise.
body: Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin confirmed on July 30, 2026, that government funding has been secured to advance domestic commercial aircraft production. At Yakovlev's Irkutsk Aircraft Plant, 18 MC-21-310 passenger aircraft are currently at various stages of production to serve launch customer Aeroflot.

According to ch-aviation data, Aeroflot is awaiting delivery of 198 MC-21-310 aircraft. The certification process for the MC-21-310 is expected to be completed in June 2027, with long-term plans targeting an annual production rate of 36 MS-21 aircraft by 2032.

The government also announced funding totaling $32.8 million (RUB 2.6 billion) for the first three production IL-114-300 turboprop aircraft developed by Ilyushin. Following type certification in June 2026, these three aircraft will be delivered to Arkhangelsk Aviation Enterprise.

en.title: Airbus Delivers First Special Operations NH90 Standard 2 Helicopter to France
en.summary: Airbus Helicopters has officially delivered the first NH90 Standard 2 helicopter to the French Armament General Directorate (DGA). Designed specifically for special operations, this new variant builds upon the NH90 TTH platform. France has ordered a total of 18 NH90 Standard 2 units scheduled for delivery by mid-2029, to be operated by the French Army Aviation's special forces squadron based in Pau. Additionally, Spain joined the development programme in December 2025 by ordering 31 NH90 helicopters in a similar configuration.
body: Airbus Helicopters has officially delivered the first NH90 Standard 2 helicopter to the French Armament General Directorate (DGA). Designed specifically for special operations, the new variant builds upon the capabilities of the proven NH90 TTH platform.

France has ordered a total of 18 NH90 Standard 2 helicopters scheduled for full delivery by mid-2029. They will be operated by the French Army Aviation's special forces squadron in Pau. Additionally, Spain joined the programme in December 2025 with an order for 31 NH90 helicopters in a similar standard.

The Standard 2 configuration integrates the Safran Euroflir 410 D electro-optical system, a new digital map generator, and enlarged rear sliding windows for self-protection weapons. The programme was originally ordered in 2020 by the NATO Helicopter Management Agency.

zh.summary: 加拿大第二大航空公司 WestJet 於2026年7月30日發布72小時鎖場通知，回應工會 CUPE 8125 代表約4400名空服員提出的罷工預告。若雙方未能達成協議，工作停頓可能於8月2日凌晨起發生。WestJet 表示目前營運未受立即影響，並為7月30日至8月4日期間的旅客提供彈性改簽與取消政策。
body: 加拿大航空公司 WestJet 於2026年7月30日表示，在加拿大公共僱員工會（CUPE）8125分會宣布72小時罷工預告後，已發布自身的72小時鎖場通知。CUPE 8125 代表約4400名 WestJet 機艙組員。
若雙方未能達成協議，工作停頓可能於2026年8月2日凌晨12時01分（山嶽時間）起發生。鎖場通知將阻止工會成員工作。
WestJet Group 執行長 Alexis von Hoensbroech 表示，發布鎖場通知的決定並非輕率做出，並對旅客造成的不便與不確定性表達誠摯遺憾。他說，WestJet 的承諾仍在談判桌上，將24小時不間斷努力達成協議。
CUPE 8125 主席 Alia Hussain 表示，罷工預告並不意味空服員希望展開工業行動，工會的目標是在不影響旅客的情況下達成公平協議。她說：「還有時間避免罷工」，工會將持續徹夜談判。
工會主張 WestJet 空服員每月從事多達35小時的無償工作，包括登機、安全檢查、協助旅客及地面延誤期間。工會表示薪酬與飛機推出時間密切相關，要求為所有工作時數支付報酬。
WestJet 表示，相關通知不會立即影響營運，也不意味必然發生勞資中斷。航空公司為2026年7月30日至8月4日期間訂位的旅客提供彈性更改與取消政策，若發生航班延誤或取消，受影響旅客將獲得退款或重新安排航班。

en.title: WestJet Issues Lockout Notice in Response to 72-Hour Cabin Crew Strike Threat
en.summary: WestJet, Canada's second-largest airline, issued a 72-hour lockout notice on July 30, 2026, after CUPE 8125, representing approximately 4,400 cabin crew, served a strike notice. If no agreement is reached, a work stoppage could begin at 12:01 a.m. Mountain Time on August 2. WestJet says operations are not immediately affected and is offering flexible change and cancellation policies for passengers travelling between July 30 and August 4.
body: Canadian carrier WestJet said on July 30, 2026, that it was issuing a lockout notice after members of the Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE) 8125 announced a 72-hour strike notice. CUPE 8125 represents approximately 4,400 WestJet cabin crew.
If an agreement is not reached, a work stoppage could occur on August 2, 2026, at 12:01 a.m. Mountain Time. The lockout notice would prevent unionized employees from working.

Alexis von Hoensbroech, CEO of the WestJet Group, said the decision to issue a lockout notice was not made lightly and expressed sincere regret for the inconvenience and uncertainty caused. He said the airline's commitment remains at the bargaining table, where it will work 24 hours a day to reach a deal.

CUPE 8125 President Alia Hussain said the strike notice does not mean flight attendants want to commence industrial action, and the union's goal is to reach a fair agreement without disrupting passengers. She added there is still time to avoid a strike and the union will continue to bargain around the clock.

The union claims WestJet flight attendants carry out unpaid work up to 35 hours every month, including boarding, safety sweeps, assisting passengers, and ground delays. CUPE 8125 says pay is heavily tied to when the aircraft pushes back and is seeking compensation for all hours worked.

WestJet said the notices do not immediately impact operations or mean that a labor disruption will occur. The airline is offering flexible change and cancellation policies for guests with travel bookings between July 30, 2026, and August 4, 2026, and said impacted guests will be refunded or reaccommodated as applicable.

zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年7月30日在聯邦登記冊發布提案，擬允許該局在審查某些商業太空發射與再入許可時，豁免遵守13項聯邦環境與自然資源法律。提案涵蓋發射與再入載具、發射與再入場域以及實驗飛行許可。FAA指出，此舉可透過刪除被視為不必要或重複的環境審查來縮短審批時間，但在特定條件下僅在運輸部長諮詢相關聯邦機構後認定該法律不需保護公眾健康與安全、財產、國家安全或美國對外政策利益時才得適用。受影響法律包括國家環境政策法、瀕危物種法、清潔水法、清潔空氣法、國家史料保存法、海洋哺乳類保護法、海岸帶管理法、國家海洋聖殿法、噪音控制法、野生與風景河流法、河流與港口法、瑪格努森-史蒂文斯漁業保暨管理法及運輸部法部分條款。公眾意見徵求期間將持續至2026年8月31日。
body: FAA表示，商業太空活動快速成長，現行環境審查流程涉及多項法律與多個聯邦機構，導致審查重複且延誤。
提案將僅適用於在最終規則生效後發出或修改的許可證與許可；FAA將在審閱公眾意見後決定是否採納此變更。
根據FAA的數據，2025財政年度共授權204項商業太空作業，2026年預測為214項，至2036年可能達到每年507項，未來十年累計可能達4,288項。
該提案呼應2025年8月的一項行政命令，該命令要求聯邦機構加速商業發射、航天器再入及太空港專案的審批程序。

en.title: FAA Proposes Waiving Environmental Reviews to Accelerate Commercial Space Launches
en.summary: On July 30, 2026, the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) published a notice in the Federal Register proposing to allow the agency to waive compliance with 13 federal environmental and natural-resource statutes when reviewing certain commercial space launch and reentry licenses and permits. The waiver would cover launch and reentry vehicles, launch and reentry sites, and experimental flight permits. FAA says the change could shorten approval times by eliminating reviews it deems unnecessary or duplicative, but only when the Transportation Secretary, after consulting the appropriate federal agency, determines a legal requirement is not needed to protect public health and safety, property, national security, or U.S. foreign policy interests. The affected statutes include the National Environmental Policy Act, Endangered Species Act, Clean Water Act, Clean Air Act, National Historic Preservation Act, Marine Mammal Protection Act, Coastal Zone Management Act, National Marine Sanctuaries Act, Noise Control Act, Wild and Scenic Rivers Act, Rivers and Harbors Act, Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act, and part of the Department of Transportation Act. The public comment period runs through August 31, 2026. FAA noted that in some cases waiving its review may shift responsibility to another federal agency rather than eliminate the review entirely.
body: FAA emphasized that commercial space activity is surging and that the current regulatory process involves multiple laws and agencies, leading to overlapping reviews and delays.
The proposal would apply only to licenses and permits issued or modified after a final rule takes effect; FAA will review public comments before deciding whether to adopt the change.

According to FAA data, it authorized a record 204 commercial space operations in fiscal year 2025, forecasts 214 for 2026, and as many as 507 annually by 2036, and expects up to 4,288 operations over the next decade.

The initiative follows an August 2025 executive order directing federal agencies to speed approvals for commercial launches, spacecraft reentries, and spaceport projects, and relies on authority under the Commercial Space Launch Act that permits the Transportation Secretary to waive a federal legal requirement for a license or permit under certain conditions.
